patch_list: Removes the root-detection block so the app can be used on rooted devices.

Stops Firebase Analytics and CleverTap reporting, AppsFlyer attribution, and Facebook automatic app events/advertiser-ID collection. CleverTap push/in-app initialisation is disabled; crash reporting and Branch deep links are kept.

Unlocks premium and freemium features in the app, including the full macro and micronutrient breakdown for food items and the dashboard freemium card locks, locked-state CTAs (e.g. "Unlock Macros"), and the expired-trial tag chips. Server-…
